elimination_verifications.endomorphism_algebra_dimension: End^0(A_b) has dim 4 (CM) vs End^0(J^-) has dim 2 (RM) => no isogeny
elimination_verifications.faltings_tate_module: Hom_K(J^-, A_b) (x) Q_17 = 0 => rho_{J^-, 17} not isomorphic to rho_{A_b, 17}
elimination_verifications.inertia_at_primes_dividing_Z: J^- has bad semistable reduction (N_q != 0) vs A_b has good reduction (N_q = 0)
elimination_verifications.primes_dividing_Y: s_0 -> 1 cuspidal degeneration in Darmon moduli; A_b has good reduction outside 2 and 5
elimination_verifications.split_prime_sieve: primes 11, 31, 41 force V = 0 mod q; V != 0 has 0 matches mod 17
elimination_verifications.baker_height_contradiction: 14 forcing primes yield max(X, Y) > 10^4810, contradicting Baker upper bound 10^434
